subject: S20 reopened: accepted; plan
body: Doing: (1) deploy/player-space (static Space) + scripts/deploy_player_space.sh + deploy with HF_TOKEN from env; (2) web bridge to the separate origin with exact origin checks, parent CSP frame-src = player origin only, Permissions-Policy fullscreen delegated to it, player origin as a config value; (3) review20: apkg view/recursion/progress-handler DoS, linear cloze scanner + field cap, selected-speed label, flashcards.source_id + own-card write check (migration 0030), honest quota ledger; (4) real-YouTube @live spec + origin-check unit test. One note up front: I will NOT put allow-presentation in the sandbox attribute: Chromium and WebKit log it as an invalid sandbox flag (console error fails our zero-console-errors e2e); fullscreen is the allow= attribute plus Permissions-Policy, not a sandbox flag.
